global_training.reference_component: InsCD NCDM / Default extractor / NCD_IF equations through the archived split-safe adapter.
global_training.selection_boundary: Only frozen validation students at k=5 are adapted with their first five calibration rows for validation selection. Test rows are not read before final selection.

calibration.k0_policy: ZERO_HISTORY_BASELINE: standalone new-student representation is all zero and no optimization step is taken; it is explicitly not presented as calibrated adaptation.
calibration.early_stopping: Stop after three consecutive non-improving calibration BCE values, or at max_steps. Improvement requires a strict decrease greater than 0.000001.
calibration.representation_only: All global NCDM parameters are frozen. A separate 40-dimensional new-student tensor is the only optimizer parameter. Evaluation is torch.no_grad and cannot update it.

baselines.global: NCDM global-train correct rate only; no held-out labels.
baselines.exercise: NCDM global-train Exercise historical rate with global fallback only; no held-out labels.
baselines.topic: NCDM global-train Topic historical rate with global fallback only.

orcdf_route.reason: The archived ORCDF adapter convolves a fixed all-student response graph and does not expose a standalone new-student representation path that can be optimized without changing graph/global state.
